method: Digest-bound original ELF disassembly and static dataflow inspection; no native execution or emulation.
limitations: Extends credited2154/3374 arithmetic with real negative replacement and positive occupied-or-zero entry semantics, plus owned map composition.
Valid unique-key input and positive-seed maps are premises. Do not infer arbitrary duplicated wire rows; a well-formed input map cannot visit the same key twice.

Native allocation, tree balancing/conversion, iterator safety and diagnostic side effects remain excluded. General tree insertion delegates structural helpers; new source uses its own BTreeMap, not a claim of physical layout equivalence.
Full simulation transformations, portfolio economics and complete component gates remain open. No target instructions executed or emulated.
